title: Machine Learning Approaches for Predicting Difficult Airway and First-Pass Success in the Emergency Department: Multicenter Prospective Observational Study.
summary: Seven machine-learning models predicted difficult airway and first-pass intubation success in a prospective multicenter emergency-department cohort and were compared with the modified LEMON reference.
ai_technology: the JEAN-2 prospective multicenter cohort and outcomes; Results compare model discrimination with the clinical reference.
